My dear [Miss Bramston](/person/198)[^1]
I shall have much pleasure in dining with you next Thursday It is lucky the [lectures](/topic/240) are over today, or it would not have been easy to manage it[^2]

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Mary Bramston is recorded in the 1871 census living in Winchester with her brother [John](/person/196) who was a master at [Winchester College](/organisation/50).
[^2]: The Englishwoman’s Review 1 (January 1870), 27 notes, \'Lectures to ladies on English literature are to be given by Professor Morley, at Winchester in the autumn.\'
